subject: Better support request tracking
description: Support operators can now review bug reports and feature requests, update their status, and track request history in the support console.

subject: Report bugs and request features
description: You can now report a bug or request a feature right from the profile menu. Add a subject and description (and a severity for bugs) and send it our way. Available on web and mobile.

subject: A friendlier empty dashboard
description: When there are no open chores, the dashboard now shows a clear, friendly message with an icon and a quick action to add a chore, instead of a single line of text.

subject: Friendlier first steps
description: Parents whose family has no kids yet now see a gentle prompt to add their first family member, and brand-new players get a quick welcome explaining how to earn and spend coins. Both can be dismissed.

subject: First-time Google sign-in
description: Fixed an error that could stop brand-new accounts from finishing their first Google sign-in and creating their family.

subject: A head start for new families
description: New families now begin with a guided getting-started checklist, example categories, and a starter reward so your dashboard is ready to use right away. Complete the steps to set up your family, then edit or remove anything to make it your own.

subject: Group chore approval payouts
description: Fixed group chore approval so parents can exclude assignees and the remaining coins re-split automatically before approval.

subject: Faster chore editing
description: The add chore form now keeps the most-used fields up front, remembers additional options, and defaults the assignee from your dashboard filter.

subject: Dashboard chore deletion
description: Removed the extra delete animation from dashboard chore cards so chores disappear more cleanly.

subject: Notification badge clearing
description: Fixed an issue where the unseen notification count could stay visible after a player viewed unseen notifications.

subject: Language support
description: Users can now choose their preferred language, parents can update language settings for family members, and quests can support localized content.

subject: Newly added chores on dashboard
description: Fixed an issue where some newly added chores did not appear on the dashboard or all chores table right away.
